wf.title: Two-Page Canva Product Catalogue
wf.brief: I’ll supply a ChatGPT-generated reference that already contains every product detail I want featured. Your task is to translate that information into a polished, two-page catalogue in Canva that feels clean and professional from front to back. The catalogue is strictly product-focused, so each item needs clear hierarchy—crisp imagery, concise copy blocks, consistent typography, and a neat price call-out. I’m looking for a layout that looks ready for both digital sharing and high-resolution print. Deliverables • Editable Canva link so I can tweak or duplicate pages later • Print-ready PDF (A4, 300 dpi) and a web-optimised PDF Once I send the ChatGPT reference, I’d like a quick first draft for
wf.summary: Client wants a clean two-page, product-focused Canva catalogue, delivered as an editable link plus print and web PDFs.
wf.skill: Briefing the client before you design

practice.q: The client is sending a ChatGPT reference with all product details. What is the most important thing to do before designing?
options: Start designing straight away in Canva
Check the reference for missing or unclear product details
Add extra pages to make it look fuller
practice.why: The client already wrote the content, but it may have gaps or errors. Confirm prices, names and images first, or you'll redesign around bad information.
practice.need: I'll check your product reference for gaps, then build a clean two-page Canva catalogue with print and web PDFs.

wf.title: Mobile Accessories Digital Catalogue
wf.brief: I'm seeking a designer to create a professional digital catalogue for my mobile accessories. This catalogue will be used primarily for retailers and distributors. The catalogue should include: - Product photos - Product name - Model compatibility The final deliverable should be an editable design file, allowing for future updates as needed. Ideal skills and experience: - Proficiency in graphic design software (e.g., Adobe InDesign, Canva) - Experience in creating professional product catalogues - Strong attention to detail and design aesthetics - Ability to provide an editable format for future modifications
wf.summary: Client wants a professional editable digital catalogue of mobile accessories with photos, product names and model compatibility, for retailers.
wf.skill: Briefing the client: finding what the buyer really needs

practice.q: What is the most important thing the client needs from this catalogue, beyond looking nice?
options: Retailers can quickly find the right product for each phone model
Each page is filled with as many photos as possible
The catalogue is printed in full colour on glossy paper
practice.why: Retailers buy by compatibility. A layout that makes it fast to find a product for a specific phone model matters more than decoration. Editable files matter too, since the catalogue will change.
practice.need: I'll build an editable catalogue where retailers find each accessory's model compatibility in seconds.

wf.title: Modern Promotional Poster Design
wf.brief: I’m looking for a designer who can translate my business message into a clean, creative, and modern promotional poster. The poster’s sole purpose is to promote our product / service, so it has to capture attention quickly, communicate benefits at a glance, and remain consistent with our existing brand style. Here’s what I have in mind: • Visual approach: bold yet tidy layout, contemporary typography, and a colour palette that feels fresh without straying from our current branding. • Readability: information must be organised so a first-time viewer instantly grasps the key points and call-to-action. • Print-ready: final artwork should be supplied as a high-resolution PDF (CMYK, 300 dpi) along
wf.summary: Client wants a bold, modern promo poster for their product/service, matching existing brand style, print-ready as 300dpi CMYK PDF.
wf.skill: Making the offer impossible to miss

practice.q: What does the client really need from this poster?
options: Show every detail of the product on one poster
Make the key benefit and call-to-action grasped at a glance
Use as many bright colours and fonts as possible
practice.why: Posters are seen for seconds. The brief asks for quick attention, benefits understood at a glance, and a clear call-to-action, all while staying on brand. Clutter and too many styles work against that.
practice.need: I'll design a bold, clean poster that keeps your brand style and makes your offer clear at a glance.

wf.title: Design Luxury Fashion Course Brochures
wf.brief: Hi, I am looking for a professional graphic designer to design 4 premium course brochures for BIFD (Bhuvan Institute of Fashion Design). Requirements: 1. 3 Aari Work Course Brochures (Basic, Advanced & Professional). 2. 1 Fashion Design Course Brochure. Design Expectations: - Premium, luxury and professional editorial-style design. - Elegant colour combinations with deep green, ivory/cream and champagne gold. - Professional typography with proper font pairing. - Clean layouts with sufficient whitespace. - High-quality fashion and embroidery photographs. - Consistent BIFD branding across all brochures. - Proper page alignment, hierarchy and readability. Deliverables: - Print-ready PDF (A4 siz
wf.summary: Client wants 4 premium A4 print-ready course brochures for BIFD: three Aari Work levels and one Fashion Design, in deep green, ivory and champagne gold.
wf.skill: Briefing the client and locking brand consistency across a set

practice.q: Which deliverable most needs careful brand consistency and print readiness before anything else?
options: Matching BIFD branding across all four brochures
Choosing the cheapest stock photos available
Making each brochure a different colour scheme
practice.why: Consistent branding across the set is what makes four brochures read as one premium BIFD family. Print-ready A4 files and clear hierarchy follow from that.
practice.need: I'll deliver four matching A4 print-ready BIFD brochures in your deep green, ivory and gold palette.

wf.title: Instagram Branding Posts & Ads
wf.brief: I own Shivam Medical Food Supplements Store together with the PodiaFitnessLife gym in Panipat-Safidon-Jind, Haryana. To strengthen the brand and earn greater trust online, I need a fresh set of Instagram-ready visuals—both regular feed content and paid ad creatives—that highlight our premium supplements, modern gym facility and authentic customer results. I already handle day-to-day sales and training, so what I need from you is design expertise: eye-catching layouts, consistent colour palettes, clear typography and imagery that speaks to fitness lovers in North India. Content should feel informative rather than pushy, focusing on product quality, workout tips, client testimonials and behind
wf.summary: Design Instagram feed posts and paid ad creatives for a supplements store and gym in Panipat, Haryana, to build trust.
wf.skill: Briefing the client: matching visuals to the real goal

practice.q: What does the client most need from these visuals, based on the brief?
options: Flashy, high-pressure sales graphics
Informative, trustworthy visuals showing quality and results
Video reels with filmed workout footage
practice.why: The client wants informative, trust-building content, not pushy ads. Focus on product quality, tips, and real testimonials. Video and filming are outside this job, so leave those out.
practice.need: I'll design consistent, trust-building Instagram posts and ad creatives that showcase your supplements and gym.

cv.title: Modern Office CV & Letter
cv.brief: I need a polished set of application materials—CV, résumé, and cover letter—tailored specifically to office and administration roles. The final documents must look contemporary and professional while remaining clean and ATS-friendly. Please craft the layout in Microsoft Word, Canva, or any comparable platform, then supply both the editable files and ready-to-send PDFs. I value precise formatting, flawless grammar, and consistent styling throughout; no typos or spacing mishaps should slip through. Timely delivery is equally important to me. If you have several years of experience writing CVs for administrative careers, I want to hear from you. When you respond, focus on that experience; a con
cv.summary: Client wants polished, ATS-friendly CV, résumé and cover letter for office/admin roles, in editable and PDF form.
cv.skill: Matching documents to the target role's requirements

practice.q: What does the client most need from this job?
options: Fast, flawless, ATS-friendly application documents
Hiring the client's staff for their office
Running a full marketing campaign for their job search
practice.why: Read the brief closely: it asks for clean, ATS-friendly CV and cover letter documents, not recruiting or marketing. Spot the deliverable first, then the constraints.
practice.need: I'll deliver a clean, ATS-friendly CV, résumé and cover letter for your office role, in editable and PDF form.

cv.title: ATS-Ready STEM Resume Revamp
cv.brief: I need a skilled resume writer to turn my existing CV into a clean, modern document that sails through Applicant Tracking Systems on Naukri and Indeed. My background: a STEM Master’s degree and more than three years of experience in data-focused environments. I am now targeting roles in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and, to a lesser extent, software development, cloud, or broader IT functions. Your task is to refashion the content with strong action verbs, tightly focused bullet points, and the right mix of keywords so recruiters can find me quickly. The design should be minimalist—no graphics that trip ATS—yet visu
cv.summary: Client wants an ATS-friendly, minimalist resume rewrite for data/STEM roles on Naukri and Indeed.
cv.skill: Structuring a CV that machines and recruiters can both read

practice.q: Which resume design choice best suits an ATS-friendly CV for data roles?
options: Two-column layout with icons and a photo
Single-column, plain text, standard headings
Infographic skill bars and colored graphics
practice.why: ATS software parses plain text in standard sections best. Icons, photos and graphics often get scrambled or skipped, so a single column with clear headings keeps your keywords readable.
practice.need: I'll turn your CV into a clean, ATS-ready data resume that gets you found on Naukri and Indeed.

cv.title: ATS-Friendly Resume Rewrite
cv.brief: I'm seeking a professional resume rewrite to help me apply for an Armed Federal Security Guard position. The goal is to make my resume cleaner and optimized to pass Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS). Key Focus Areas: - Emphasize relevant skills and experience - Ensure formatting is ATS-friendly - Maintain clarity and professionalism Ideal skills and experience: - Proven expertise in resume writing - Familiarity with ATS requirements - Experience with security-related job applications
cv.summary: Client wants an ATS-friendly resume rewrite to apply for an Armed Federal Security Guard job.
cv.skill: Structuring a CV that passes ATS screening

practice.q: What does the client actually need from this rewrite?
options: A clean, ATS-friendly resume highlighting relevant security experience
A fancy designed resume with graphics and photos
A cover letter written from scratch with no resume
practice.why: Good. The client wants a clean, keyword-friendly CV that passes ATS filters and shows relevant security experience. Design flourishes can break ATS parsing, so skip them.
practice.need: I'll rewrite your CV into a clean, ATS-friendly format that highlights your security experience for the armed guard role.

cv.title: Sales-Focused CV Creation
cv.brief: I want a brand-new CV built from my existing work history, positioned squarely for sales and customer service roles. The document should highlight achievements, metrics, and transferable soft skills in language that resonates with hiring managers and sails through ATS filters. A clean, modern layout that looks just as good in Word as it does in PDF is essential. I will supply my full employment chronology, education, and any figures you need. From there, I expect you to craft concise, persuasive wording, organise the sections logically, and weave in role-specific keywords without sounding forced. Please showcase your experience creating high-impact CVs—especially for sales or customer servic
cv.summary: Client wants a new sales and customer service CV built from their work history, with metrics and ATS-friendly keywords.
cv.skill: Turning past duties into measurable achievements

practice.q: What does the client most need from this CV to get shortlisted for sales and customer service roles?
options: Achievements and metrics, keyword-rich for ATS
A long list of every past duty in order
A decorative design with photos and icons
practice.why: Hiring managers and ATS filters both reward proof of results and matching keywords. Lead with measurable wins, then choose a clean layout that works in Word and PDF.
practice.need: I'll turn your work history into a sales-focused CV with metrics, keywords, and a clean layout for Word and PDF.

cv.title: Innovative Venture Builder CV Rewrite
cv.brief: I’m preparing to go into a startup-focused innovation role, specifically in venture building and new business and product development, and I need my existing CV transformed so it speaks the language that founders, VCs, and corporate venture arms expect. You’ll take my current résumé, dig into the achievements that prove I can spot opportunities, validate markets, and launch products, then recast them with clear impact metrics and keywords recruiters’ ATS systems flag—terms like “lean experimentation,” “MVP,” “go-to-market,” and “fund-raising.” The tone has to balance entrepreneurial energy with strategic rigour, showing I can move from vision to viable business while steering cross-functiona
cv.summary: Client wants their CV rewritten for venture building and innovation roles, using founder/VC keywords and impact metrics.
cv.skill: Turning experience into proof of impact

practice.q: What does the client most need from this rewrite?
options: Shorter CV with fewer achievements
Achievements reframed with impact metrics and ATS keywords
A cover letter written from scratch
practice.why: The brief is about turning existing achievements into opportunity-spotting, validation, and launch evidence, with metrics and keywords recruiters scan for. Shortening or replacing the letter misses the point.
practice.need: I'll turn your launches and market wins into metric-led bullets that speak to founders and VCs.

ig.title: Social Media Ad Design Specialist
ig.brief: I need a creative designer to create engaging social media posts and ads for Instagram and Facebook. The main goal of these designs is to promote our Sports and fitness brand Key Requirements: - Create visually appealing and engaging designs. - Platform-specific designs for Instagram and Facebook. - Focus on product/service promotion. Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proven experience in social media design. - Strong portfolio showcasing relevant work. - Proficiency in design software (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite). - Ability to understand and incorporate brand guidelines. - Knowledge of current design trends and social media algorithms. Please provide a portfolio with your bids.
ig.summary: Client wants eye-catching Instagram and Facebook ads and posts that promote their sports and fitness brand, matched to brand guidelines.
ig.skill: Designing posts that promote the product, not just look good

practice.q: What is the main goal of these designs, according to the brief?
options: Make the feed look pretty and artistic
Promote the brand's product or service
Grow followers with general brand awareness
practice.why: The brief says the main goal is promoting the product or service. Pretty designs matter, but a post that doesn't sell or promote misses the point of the job.
practice.need: I'll design Instagram and Facebook ads that promote your sports and fitness products, following your brand guidelines.

ig.title: Social Media Post and Graphic Creation
ig.brief: I’m looking for a creative partner who can take full ownership of designing eye-catching social media content for my brand. The core of the job is simple: plan and produce original posts—both the copy and the accompanying graphics—that feel on-brand and encourage engagement. Here’s what I need from you each week: • 3–5 static or carousel images sized for Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn • Short, punchy captions (with relevant hashtags) that align with the visuals • Editable source files (Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator) along with export-ready PNG/JPG versions I’ll supply brand guidelines, recent campaign examples, and any photography assets I already have. From there, you’ll brainstorm, d
ig.summary: Client wants weekly on-brand Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn posts: 3-5 images, punchy captions with hashtags, and editable source files.
ig.skill: Anatomy of a post that sells: copy and visuals working together

practice.q: What does the client actually need from this role, beyond making posts look pretty?
options: Attractive designs that win design awards
On-brand posts that drive engagement every week
A full social media strategy and ad campaigns
practice.why: The brief asks for weekly on-brand posts that encourage engagement, not just pretty visuals or strategy work. Each post needs matching copy, correct sizing per platform, and editable files. Keep the goal of engagement in view for every piece.
practice.need: I'll deliver weekly on-brand posts with punchy captions, sized for each platform and engagement-focused.

ig.title: Minimalist Canva To-Do List Design
ig.brief: I need a clean, minimalist two-page to-do list created in Canva, sized for US Letter. Both pages must be fully editable so I can tweak colours, text and layout later. Page one carries the main heading “TO DO LIST”, then splits into two even columns: “PERSONAL” on the left, “WORK” on the right. Under each column the weekdays Monday through Friday appear as simple text labels only—no boxes or separator lines—leaving open space beneath every day for handwriting. Page two repeats the “TO DO LIST” heading and uses the same two-column structure for “PERSONAL” and “WORK”, but this time only Saturday and Sunday sit under each column. Directly below, the page divides horizontally into three clear sec
ig.summary: Client wants a 2-page editable US Letter Canva to-do list: Personal/Work columns, weekdays on page 1, weekend on page 2, plus three sections below.
ig.skill: Matching the design to the user's actual use

practice.q: Why does the client want the weekday and weekend days split across two pages, with blank space left under each day?
options: So the design looks more decorative
So the user has room to handwrite tasks for each day
So the file prints faster on US Letter
practice.why: Read the brief for the purpose, not just the layout. The blank space under each day is for handwriting, so the design must stay open and uncluttered. Keep every element minimal so the writing space is never crowded.
practice.need: I'll build a clean, editable two-page Canva to-do list with open handwriting space under each day.

ig.title: Canva Social Media Graphics
ig.brief: I need a versatile Canva designer who can turn my ideas into eye-catching Instagram posts and stories, Facebook posts and ad creatives, plus LinkedIn posts and header banners. Every graphic should push one clear purpose—promoting our products and services—while staying consistent with our brand colours, fonts, and voice. Here’s how I picture the workflow: I’ll share a short brief for each campaign (headline, key message, and any reference images). You’ll translate that into on-brand visuals that feel native to each platform’s dimensions and best practices. All source files must remain editable in Canva so we can tweak copy or swap images later if needed. Deliverables for each campaign: • Ins
ig.summary: Client wants on-brand Canva graphics for Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn, each promoting products or services, all editable.
ig.skill: Making the offer impossible to miss

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need from each graphic?
options: Pretty visuals with varied styles per platform
One clear promotional purpose per graphic, on-brand and editable
Original photography and video for every campaign
practice.why: The brief is clear: every graphic pushes one purpose, sells the product or service, and stays on-brand and editable. Pretty alone misses the point. Match each platform's sizes and keep files open for later edits.
practice.need: I'll make each post sell one clear offer, on-brand and fully editable in Canva, for every platform.

ig.title: Social Ads Designer for Client Packs
ig.brief: Facebook and Instagram Ad Designer, Per-Project Work, English and Spanish. Rodgate Digital designs and runs ads for US small businesses. We need designers we can send ad packs to as clients order them. Typical order: 3 to 10 static ads in feed (1:1 or 4:5) and story (9:16) sizes, from a brief and brand kit we provide. Paid per pack through Freelancer.com. Our budget is about $100 for one 5-ad pack in 2 sizes. Work starts when a client orders. You have: - A portfolio of real social ads, not just posts - Editable source files (PSD, AI, Figma or Canva) with every order - A 48 to 72 hour turnaround on a 5-ad pack - Spanish is a plus In your bid, include: 1) Links to your 5 best ad designs. 2) Yo
ig.summary: Design 3-10 Facebook/Instagram static ads (1:1, 4:5, 9:16) per client order from their brief and brand kit, for US small businesses.
ig.skill: Making the offer impossible to miss

practice.q: A client orders a 5-ad pack. Which should you do first to make each ad sell?
options: Pick the trendiest template and fill it in
Lock in the offer and one clear call to action
Make every ad a different style to test variety
practice.why: Ads for small shops work when one offer and one action are impossible to miss. Pretty comes second. Start from the brief's offer and CTA, then design around them.
practice.need: I'll build each ad around the offer and CTA in your brief, delivered in 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 with editable source files.
